test_cases.name: Toytopia - Initial Availability Inquiry for Quote Lifecycle
test_cases.description: A verbose customer email from Toytopia inquiring about the availability of several catalog items in English, establishing context for a quote and order lifecycle. The request is detailed, includes business context, and references specific catalog items using their display names. The email is neutral in tone and provides explicit context for the intended workflow.

initial_turn.subject: Inquiry Regarding Product Availability for Upcoming Quote and Order
initial_turn.body:
Hello,

This is Toytopia reaching out to inquire about the current availability of several items, as we are planning to place an order soon and would like to request a quote based on your response. We are preparing for our upcoming seasonal inventory refresh, so timely information will help us coordinate our purchasing schedule.

Could you please confirm whether the following products are available for immediate shipment:

- WonderWagon Pull-Along Train
- JoySprout Toy Car Set
- SmartToys Jigsaw Puzzle Set
- Generic Golden T-Shirt

If you could also provide any relevant details regarding lead times or minimum order quantities, that would be greatly appreciated. Once we have your availability confirmation, we will proceed to request a quote and finalize our order accordingly.

Best regards,
Toytopia

initial_turn.subject: Inquiry Regarding Availability of Multiple Items for Upcoming Order
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are currently planning our next round of inventory replenishment and would like to inquire about the availability of several items listed in your catalog. Specifically, we are interested in the following:

- T-Shirt (we noticed there are multiple T-Shirts in your catalog; could you please confirm which styles or variants are currently available?)
- Organic Carrot
- WonderWagon Bicycle
- Pizza (we see multiple Pizza options; could you clarify which types are in stock?)

We would appreciate it if you could provide details regarding current stock levels, lead times, and any relevant information about these products. This will help us prepare for a quote request and subsequent order.

Best regards,
Fresh HelloFoods

- Mango

I need this information urgently for our next menu update and staff uniforms. Please reply promptly and don't make me chase you for basic details.

German Cafe

Best regards,
German Cafe
